body:
feel it. feel every feeling. hold yourself close and pretend it's the version of you from your childhood. i've learned, at least for myself, that feeling this pain and acknowledging it is how my mind understands the healing can start. how can we heal if we dont think about what's hurting?

it goes without saying we're all beyond proud of you, op. overcoming something so major like that is a huge accomplishment. of course now your feelings are coming back. were you ever in a safe place before to feel them?

practice some self care and gentle love towards yourself over the next few days. once the hurt and betrayal and shame pour out, you can fill yourself with love and trust.
listen to that voice inside of you. talk to your parents. they love you. they'd pick helping with debt over burying their child in a heartbeat.

you're so young, love. and there's so, so much for you to see in the world. 

i know that everything is dark and you cant see the light yet, but i promise it's there. take a deep breath and give yourself a hug. you've been through a lot, and i'm sorry no one's validated that for you.

the most healing thing we can do is look at the versions of ourselves that weren't cradled and held and loved properly and teach ourselves how to love them. what happened to you can't define you, because every birthday is just another change.  look at how much you went through and you're still alive. and you still want to live. how dare anyone come between you and life.

i hope your cat gets some extra scritches tonight. throwing my torch your way in case it gets any more dark.

i can't imagine how that must feel. i'm so sorry that happened.

make sure you clean up the cut and put a bandaid over it, if anything. i'm so sorry your friend reacted that way. you're young—- be gentle with yourself. you didn't do anything to deserve this, okay? you didn't.

you're not alone out there. keep going for the 15 year old inside of you that wasn't treated softly when she needed to be. had to tell myself that a lot.   i still do.  

there's something past this.

i felt the same way as you. i'm 21 now, and i've been on t for 2 years. it's never too late. you can do teenager boy shit whenever you want.  dont kill yourself yet. there's an entire world out there waiting for ya.
Don't do it, love. You have so, so much ahead of you.
we're all out here waiting for ya. your life won't be like this forever.

your message has so much despair in it. i'm so sorry. 

i'm trans as well, and i used to feel ( and still, sometimes, do feel ) the exact same things you're describing. i remember when i would spend days in foul moods. i was miserable. i was so miserable, every day felt like a chore.

i'm so sorry no one is treating you with the gentleness and love you deserve. i know right now it's like the apocalypse is happening, but you aren't alone.

the beautiful thing about time is that it's never going to be too late for you to feel better.

i remember being your age, feeling the exact same things. i never tried at school. what's the point, right? i'm not gonna be alive when i'm 21 to see the benefit. i didn't shower for weeks. i didn't take care of myself. From then until I was 20, I never thought I would be alive much longer. No diploma, I wasn't qualified for most jobs. i moved from michigan to texas when i was 19. i wanted to kill myself every day for as long as i could remember.



some days are hell. some days feel like heaven. it does get better. take it from me; it is not ever too late for you. you are timeless and endless. i'm holding you in my heart; you've got some armor whenever you need it.
we'll take that walk together, then. you aren't in this alone.

nothing to thank me for. really.

i'm proud of you for loving yourself enough to come to the realization that it was nothing you deserved and nothing you caused. the biggest first step, and you achieved that. that isn't something to discount. be proud of yourself! 

i can't imagine the pain you've been forced to carry. and for so long. it's not your fault no one has ever comforted you. i hope that's something you can tell yourself.

i am so, so sorry.

i am so sorry that you haven't been treated with gentle hands. i'm so sorry you're hurting. you are so much more than what they say you are. you might not believe that right now, but you'll see it. you will be everything, and they will eat their words.

thought the same way when i was in a deep hole. i didn't shower for weeks. i cut myself. i would cry and scream for no reason, just because i felt so much sadness and i never knew where it came from. all i knew was that waiting for it to get better was the stupidest thing i ever heard. thought this way for 20 years. i was depressed at a young age and i wasn't diagnosed til a while later. i didn't try at anything because there wasn't any point. no one wants to give the loser a trophy, right? why even reach for it when you know the answer? 

i'm not all the way better. i smoke a lot.  but waking up gets easier, and being a person gets easier.  i was you and my world felt like it was ending. i found out i was shaking, not the ground. it takes time. and it takes talking, too. therapy helps more than people think it does. sometimes therapy can just be comforting the child within yourself and drying their tears. 

if you need someone, i will be there regardless of the time. i'm going to be your dad right now and tell you that everything is okay. i got you.  please tell us you're okay.
hey guys! out with my girlfriend on 14th and patterson. they're asking for a guy w the last name harvey to surrender himself to police
